note: Rulings on the CoinGecko candidates of part 2 of the strata rule, read by capture-strata. An exclusion removes a coin whatever CoinGecko's data say; a Cardano-first ruling keeps a coin whose CoinGecko asset_platform_id is another chain, because its Cardano token is the original issuance.
